authorization: The Project Owner requested a goal that implements all registered blocker solutions and completes the project cleanup.

decisions.resolution: Initials are the approved canonical identity treatment when the safe account projection has no approved avatar URL. Identity artwork is not hard-coded and an absent avatar is no longer a parity blocker.

Only stored, authoritative fields already exposed by each safe domain projection are canonical. Figma-only sample aggregates and presentation fields are retired; unavailable data stays explicitly unavailable.
Existing sanitized public media URL boundaries and truthful missing-media fallbacks are canonical. No private storage key or invented asset may be rendered.

Implemented seeker viewing cancellation and account password change remain enabled. Irreversible or unapproved provider/account actions stay fail-closed and disabled as the approved canonical state until separately commissioned with authorization, audit, rollback and session-revocation rules.
Current email-only account/profile compositions supersede historical phone-era fields. Phone identity must not be inferred or restored from legacy design samples.
The owner-authored ADM-54 HTML/PNG pair is approved as the current owning source. Historical Figma recovery is not claimed; reviewed Arabic and English runtime baselines are required for closure.
